subject: why it is really slow the code of David Kahle for "Crime in Downtown Houston"

messages.author: 1e484235c6201bb6
messages.subject: why it is really slow the code of David Kahle for "Crime in Downtown Houston"
parts:
Dear all,

I was attracted by David Kahle's excellent ggplot2 maps showed in
"Crime in Downtown Houston, Texas". It is here:
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/Crime-in-Downtown-Houston%2C-Texas-%3A-Combining-ggplot2-and-Google-Maps.

But, I am facing problem when I intend to regenerate his map plot. The
execution of his R code is really slow for me. Could anyone have
experienced the same problem with me? Why is it so slow? Are there any
errors in those codes?

I would like to have your helps. Thanks in advance.

Best,

# the following codes run slow for me.

################################################################################
#################### houston crime
####################
################################################################################

load('HoustonCrime.Rdata') # variable name : crime_df

# restrict to violent crimes
violent_crimes <- subset(crime_df,
offense != 'Auto Theft' & offense != 'Theft' & offense != 'Burglary'
)

# restrict to year 2010 (january - august)
violent_crimes <- subset(violent_crimes,
time >= ISOdatetime(2010, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
)

# grab downtown google map
CityHall_latlon <- c(lon = -95.369318, lat = 29.760210)
DowntownMap <-ggooglemap(center = CityHall_latlon, zoom = 14)
lat_range <- range(DowntownMap$lat)
lon_range <- range(DowntownMap$lon)

# contour plot
ggplot() +
geom_tile(aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = fill), data = DowntownMap) +
scale_fill_identity() +
geom_density2d(aes(x = lon, y = lat, colour = ..level..),
bins = I(10), fill = NA, alpha = I(1/2), size = I(.75), data =
violent_crimes) +
scale_colour_gradient2('Violent\nCrime\nDensity',
low = 'darkblue', mid = 'orange', high = 'red', midpoint = 900) +
scale_x_continuous('Longitude', limits = lon_range) +
scale_y_continuous('Latitude', limits = lat_range) +
opts(title = 'Violent Crime Contour Map of Downtown Houston, 2010')
+
coord_equal()

Drawing pixels with geom_tile is slow because there is so much data
travelling around.
Hadley
